entities.name: Death Pits of Rath
entities.description: Chambers of oily black semi-sentient substance separating the Furnaces of Rath from the Stronghold, which developed a predatory consciousness.

entities.name: Furnaces of Rath
entities.description: Furnaces adjacent to the Death Pits whose pressure cracked the complex walls.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane of the Death Pits.

entities.name: Evincars
entities.description: Rulers of Rath who used flowstone byproduct to fill fissures.

entities.name: Carrionettes
entities.description: Undead-like puppets assembled by the Death Pits from leftovers.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship whose crew entered the Stronghold.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight the crew sought.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Event that shifted the Death Pits to Urborg.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Place on Dominaria where the Death Pits were shifted.

entities.name: Sliver Lair
entities.description: Place possibly destroyed during the Overlay.

events.summary: Evincars sent a flowstone byproduct to seal fissures; dissolved beings' memories and life forces gave the pits a predatory consciousness.
events.quote: these Death Pits developed a primitive predatory consciousness and a cruel playfulness toward prey

events.summary: During the Weatherlight's incursion the Death Pits were a hurdle to reaching Sisay.
events.quote: the Death Pits were one of the many hurdles the crew had to surpass to reach their captain, Sisay

events.summary: During the Rathi Overlay the Death Pits were shifted to Urborg in Dominaria.
events.quote: the Death Pits were shifted to Urborg in Dominaria

relations.quote: the Death Pits recombined these bits and pieces into undead-like puppets known as Carrionettes
